summary.type: Desktop application (Python, PyQt5) with real-time computer vision
summary.note: No web server, relational database, or authentication layer. Runs offline for capture, inference, and export; only map basemap tiles and GPS auto-detect need connectivity.

process: Disease classification (Panama, Black Sigatoka, BBTV, Healthy)

pipeline.name: Capture
pipeline.desc: Pull frames from the Android phone/drone mirror in real time.

pipeline.name: Preprocess
pipeline.desc: Resize, bilateral denoise, CLAHE contrast, and ECC temporal alignment for a stable feed.

pipeline.name: Detect
pipeline.desc: Run YOLOv8 inference to produce bounding boxes, confidence, and class labels.

pipeline.name: Stress map
pipeline.desc: Compute an ExG-derived vegetation stress index as a health proxy.

pipeline.name: Visualize & aggregate
pipeline.desc: Overlay detections, roll up Healthy/Stressed/Diseased counts, update map + activity log.

pipeline.name: Report & export
pipeline.desc: On Capture Frame, write a report bundle: annotated JPG, JSON, CSV, and interactive Leaflet map.

functional.title: Aerial capture via mirror
functional.text: Identify diseases from aerial input captured through a wireless drone or phone mirror feed.

functional.title: Disease detect & classify
functional.text: Classify healthy and diseased plants (Black Sigatoka, Bunchy Top, Panama, healthy) and evaluate with precision, recall, and mAP.

functional.title: Geo reports & summaries
functional.text: Provide geo-tagged disease info, health summaries, and exported reports (JSON, CSV, interactive map).

functional.title: Preprocess, stress & retrain
functional.text: Preprocess images, generate vegetation stress indicators, and support model retraining from newly labeled datasets.

nonfunctional.title: Easy to use
nonfunctional.text: Single desktop dashboard with live feed, overlays, and one-click export for non-technical users.

nonfunctional.title: Offline capable
nonfunctional.text: Capture, inference, and export work offline; maps need internet only for basemap tiles.

nonfunctional.title: Windows + Android
nonfunctional.text: PyQt5 on Windows desktop; Android as a wireless mirror source via scrcpy.

nonfunctional.title: Reliable & maintainable
nonfunctional.text: Automated smoke testing, modular pipeline architecture, low downtime during field sessions.
